facts.fact: The National Assembly of Seychelles says a first cohort of Seychelles civil servants, including its own staff, took a two-week NCGG capacity-building programme in India (11-22 May 2026) covering digital public infrastructure and AI, under an MoU to train 250 civil servants, and graduated on 22 May.
